correctness.rationale: PASS: In J(n,2) with degree 2(n-2), common-neighbor algebra A²=(d-4)I+(n-6)A+4J and AJ=dJ reduces RK4 polynomial to I,A,J. Adjacent entries are h*F_n(h)/24, nonadjacent entries h²[12-(12n-8)h+(7n²-10n+4)h²]/6; the latter quadratic has negative discriminant, and diagonals are strictly positive since r(z)=1-z+z²/2-z³/6+z⁴/24>e^-z for z>0. F_n is strictly decreasing: derivative quadratic discriminant -16 Q(n) where Q(4+t)=209t⁴+2092t³+7616t²+11808t+6480>0. Thus exact all-h positivity interval [0,tau_n]. Nonzero Laplacian eigenvalues are n,2(n-1), giving spectral stability [0,alpha/(2(n-1))] where alpha³-4alpha²+12alpha-24=0; exact comparison identity shows equality only n=4 and strict positivity/stability separation for n>=5. Scaled cubic root yields n*tau_n->gamma=1.0389..., ratio 2gamma/alpha≈0.746. The adjacency algebra gives same result for any strongly regular graph with identical parameters. Independently exact rational checks for n=4..6 validate matrix entries, not universal n.
